reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage keeps the eight allowed record IDs and correctly marks exact capability-need matches as direct while leaving unmatched needs unsupported. The two unsupported needs remain visible rather than being converted by generic keyword matching.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: map only exact handoff needs to direct capability coverage
keep missing or unsupported demand visible

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag: it sets unsupported to true when coverage == 'direct'. This ranks covered needs ahead of the actual unsupported demand records, contradicting the boundary role to rank unsupported needs before covered needs using upstream rank.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs before covered needs
use upstream provenance rank within each group
avoid treating covered alternatives as unresolved demand

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation correctly retains the explicit eight-item window and derives the recommendation from the first priority row, but its input priorities were already corrupted by the prior boundary's inverted unsupported flag. The boundary is not independently faulty, but its reported recommendation is not reliable for downstream reporting.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: construct recommendation from already-ranked first priority record
